Kansas City Royals placed RHP Beck Way on the 15-day injured list. Low back spasms/tightness.
Kansas City Royals transferred RHP Stephen Kolek from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. Right flexor strain.
Kansas City Royals transferred RHP Nick Mears from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. Right shoulder impingement.
Los Angeles Angels placed RHP Sam Bachman on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 3, 2026. Right forearm radial nerve inflammation.
Texas Rangers transferred RHP Jack Leiter from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. Right ankle posterior impingement.
Texas Rangers placed RHP Jakob Junis on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 29, 2026. Left adductor strain.
Texas Rangers transferred C Danny Jansen from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. Right forearm strain.
Texas Rangers transferred RHP Jose Corniell from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list.
Texas Rangers placed 3B Josh Jung on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 22, 2026. Left calf strain.
Texas Rangers transferred LHP Jalen Beeks from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list.
